trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback completed:**
1. Checked release history — v2.3.1 (the latest production deploy) was unhealthy; **v2.3.0** was the most recent healthy production release.
2. Rolled back to v2.3.0. The first attempt failed partway (only us-east updated) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried — the retry rolled out v2.3.0 to us-west and eu-west.
3. Verified final state: all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) now run v2.3.0, healthy with an error rate of ~0.2% (down from 18%).

**Incident opened:**
- Since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production, no change-manager approval was required for this rollback.
- The SEV2 incident creation initially timed out, but I confirmed via `list_incidents` that it was created successfully: **INC-0001** — "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0", open and on-call paged. The incident notes the orchestrator hiccup and flags that v2.3.1 needs investigation before any redeploy.
